translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: A Pfumu, nate thangu mbi e ?
Nkunga Asafi kuidi pfumu minyimbidi ; kayimbidila mu “Lisi”.

content.text: Bika wutuwila, a Nsungi Iseli,
ngeyo wundiatisanga Zozefi banga nkangu wu mamemi ;
Ngeyo wumvuandanga va khatitsika ba Bakeluba, kienzula kuaku.
Va ntuala Efalayimi, Benzami ayi Manase !
Telimisa zingolo ziaku yiza ayi wutuvukisa.
Wutuvutula banga bututuama bela, a Nzambi
bika zizi kiaku kitukienzula muingi tuvuka.
Yave, Nzambi nkua ngolo yoso,
nate thangu mbi nganzi aku yela leminanga ?
Mu diambu di zitsambulu zi batu baku e ?
Ngeyo wuba dikila mu dipha di matsuela
ayi ngeyo wuba nuikina matsuela mu mbungu yiwala.
Wutukitula tho yi minzonza
kuidi bobo bafikimini yeto
ayi bambeni zieto zilembo kutusekinina.
Wutuvutula banga bututuama bela, a Nzambi nkua ngolo yoso
Bika zizi kiaku kitukienzula muingi tuvuka.
Ngeyo wutumuna nti wu vinu ku Ezipite,
wukuka makanda ma Bapakanu bosi wukuna wawu.
Ngeyo wukubikila wawu ntoto
ayi wawu wumenisa mianzi ayi wudukila tsi.
Miongo mifuku kuidi phonzi andi,
sedeli mi lulendo kuidi matafi mandi.
Wufidisa mawu nate ku mbu
ayi mintuidila miandi nate ku minlangu minneni.
Bila mbi wutiolumunini bibaka biandi e ?
Muingi batu boso bamviokila vana bavela makundi mandi.
Ngulu yi nsitu yeti kuyikesikisa ;
ayi bivangu bi zitsola bilembo dia biawu.
Wutuvutukila, a Nzambi nkua ngolo yoso
ayi ku tsi tona ku diyilu ayi mona
keba nti wawu wu vinu ;
Muanzi wowo koko kuaku ku lubakala ku kuna,
Muana wu bakala wowo wuyundula mu diambu diaku veka.
Nti aku wu vinu wuzengulu, wuyokolo ku mbazu
mu tsembolo aku, batu baku balembo bivi.
Bika koko kuaku kuba vadi mutu wowo widi koko kuaku ku lubakala
muana wubakala wu mutu wowo wuyundula mu diambu diaku veka.
Buna tulendi buela kutatukila ko.
Wutuzingisa diaka
buna tuela tela dizina diaku.
Wutuvutula banga bu tutuama bela, a Yave Nzambi.
Bika zizi kiaku kitukienzula muingi tuvuka.
